items.title: Peter Appleyard interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 4, 2012
items.q: Chico Hamilton, good. Yeah. Chico. And she knew Chico. So we hung out.

ctx.x: I got it. I came back and he invited me to go to this party after the Royal Albert Hall you see. He said, “Come on over, come join us.” I said, “Okay.” And I was the only guy he used to invite. You know he didn’t invite everybody in the band, just, it used to be me. I used to stay at his house in New York, in the penthouse, and he’d leave me there sleeping on the couch, right next to the office, with all the information, if I’d wanted to search through it I could see all his business. He trusted me you know. I…

near it. I did what I was supposed to do. He’d take me up to Connecticut to the house there on the farm he had you know. And if he was going somewhere wherever he had to drive, he’d call me to drive him. And then afterwards we would go out to eat together you know. Anyway, we went to the Dorchester and I’m getting my fill of lobster and whatever, and this very familiar voice that I couldn’t recognize for a moment, a lady, said, “Mr. Appleyard, we were at the concert tonight and we enjoyed you so much, would you…
